evidence: AusTender notice CN3290712-A7 (Australian Maritime Safety Authority, published 3 Jul 2026) lists a contract value of $9,626,000,000.00 and an amendment value of $9,619,420,000.00, executed on 12 May 2026, while the contract period on the same notice ends on 5 Nov 2024. The previous notice, CN3290712-A6 (19 Jun 2024), lists $6,580,000.00 (https://www.tenders.gov.au/Search/KeywordSearch?keyword=CN3290712). OPAX shows the value as published and leaves it out of totals until AusTender confirms or corrects it.
